sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', d.date)::date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '152' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'Cty-BaoYen' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', d.date) ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the sum of total passengers (y) for route 152 operated by Cty-BaoYen, aggregated by month (ds).
